Yas Marina Circuit - survey

Abu Dhabi GP, UAE - circuit id abudhabi - def theme desert (brief: desert_marina_night), night:true - survey date 2026-10-15 - READ-ONLY (no js/css edits).
Build: deploy tip 6508220 + merges of cursor/shared-shot-tooling-5b45 (weather tooling) and cursor/day-wet-lighting-b7b8 (PR #1979). Merged tip 6bd1ab1; verify-track abudhabi OK on the merged tree. Frames in this report: 113. Frames of the weather matrix (day/dusk/night/dawn x dry/overcast/fog/wet/rain) were captured on the pre-merge lighting; storm, hero and the "post-merge" pair were captured after the merge.

1. Top findings

  1. Main-straight and north-hairpin dressing is displaced by +0.1015 lap (~536 m) from where the brief and the code comments place it (measured, section 7).
  2. Hotel LED "gridshell" reads as seven thin flat ribbons over a dark deck, not a lattice veil; the hotel itself is at racing 0.982, not the brief's 0.88.
  3. Pine trees appear in the desert (49 tree guard-drops; conifers in day f50, f67); the def asks for palms.
  4. Fog has no visible effect in the day frames; palm canopies and light-pool discs frost white in wet/rain.
  5. Backdrop dune ridges read as hard-edged brown slabs; yachts stand on the sand shore at f72; 1 severe clip spot (4.76 m) at the pit-exit tunnel portal.

7. Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

  1. HIGH - measured. Landmark dressing is keyed in the scenery frame, 0.1015 lap away from where the brief and comments place it.
    Mechanism: sceneryStartFrac: 0.075 (js/circuits/abudhabi.js:11) makes def._sceneryShift (js/track/tracks.js:71) move every wrapped helper by +0.1015 lap (~536 m). The file compensates only the start gantry (js/circuits/scenery/abudhabi.js:165-167). Measured: modelDiagnostics puts gantry-81 (the "photo gantry before T1", :734) at racing 0.0615 and the arches at 0.9735-0.9895; the "North Hairpin" stands, canopies, floodlights, crane and tyre walls (:61-62, 82-83, 233-239, 256-262, 677-678, 737-750, all key 0.27-0.31) land at racing ~0.38 where the corner radius is ~3.5 km (a straight), while the real hairpin (T3-T4, R 47 m, 153 deg) at racing 0.248 has only a hedge and palms (frames hero-hairpin-dressing-f38, hero-true-hairpin-f25). The pit garages, pit wall, main grandstand and motorhomes (:148-161, 671, 707-717, scenery 0.985-0.07) likewise land at racing ~0.09-0.17, not at the line; the pit-exit portal (:176-192) lands at racing 0.147 and is the 4.76 m clip spot.
    Fix: re-key the intended-racing items with the existing sl() helper (:165-166), e.g. sl(0.248) for the hairpin; re-measure with a.modelDiagnostics() and audit-circuit. The hotel (0.9815) and its tunnel/hotel neighbours are plausibly right as built; decide per landmark. Unverified: whether the offset is intentional for the OSM trace origin (the comment at :162-164 suggests only the gantry was meant to be compensated).
  2. MED - observed, mechanism likely. Hotel gridshell reads as thin flat ribbons. Seven overheadSpan arches (:454-463, thickness 0.65, depth 2.2) read as coloured bars on thin posts over a dark deck (hero-yas-hotel-racing-f98); brief section 6 asks for a continuous LED lattice via gridshellCanopy + underpassPortal, and gridshellCanopy is not even destructured at :9-15. Fix: build a lattice (cross-members) or use the shared canopy helper if the api exposes it.
  3. MED - observed, mechanism unverified. Conifers in a desert. Day f50/f67 show many pines; verify drops 49 tree props; the def sets furniture.tree: "palm" (js/circuits/abudhabi.js:52) and the file's forestEdge calls pass pineFrac: 0.0 (:633-643), so the pines are likely the engine's default scatter. Fix: trace in js/track/scenery/* (not this pair), or extend dressingExclusions (def:20-27) to kind "tree"; note exclusions are listed in racing fracs and the 0.50-0.92 span does not cover where pines appear (f50).
  4. MED - observed. Weather response. Day fog looks identical to day dry at f50; wet/rain frost palm canopies and pool discs white (snow-like). Pre-merge day rain had a clear-blue sky over dusky ground; PR #1979 fixes that (post-merge frames are coherent grey). Fog/frost live in the lighting/material engine (js/lighting/*), outside the pair. Fix: engine side; verify with lightState.
  5. LOW - observed. Backdrop dune boxes. The backdrop(...) ridges (:804-826, 15 boxes, 9 guard drops) show as hard-edged brown rectangles behind Ferrari World and on the horizon (hero-ferrari-world-az135, hero-hairpin-dressing-f38). Fix: replace with mountain() rings (already used at :97-120) or lower and widen the boxes.
  6. LOW - observed, mechanism unverified. Marina yachts on dry sand. At racing 0.722 the water is a flat band beyond a hedge wall while hull boxes sit on the shore (:317-323, 597-606, 775-790 at gap 46-58 vs waterBand gap 18 at :281). Fix: measure the shelf with groundY/ground-audit, then move yachts or the band.
  7. LOW - observed. Blank stand rears and rainbow bleacher. Sandstone-livery stands show featureless tan rear walls with an orange lip (f18, f88, hotel az315); the Marsa bleacher at :557-565 reads as a steep multi-colour plank wall.
  8. LOW - documentation. Brief and comments state scenery-frame positions as lap positions (hotel "s=0.88", Ferrari 0.18, marina 0.62; docs/tracks/abudhabi.md section 4) - built at racing 0.982 / 0.281 / 0.722 - and stale bankZones labels (def:31-36). Fix: state the frame in the brief.
  9. LOW. Day sky is a uniform saturated blue without the brief's warm horizon (palette is dusk/night-tuned; the circuit's default time is night). A small black rectangle sits on the ground near the camera in day f17 (unidentified). Night rain/storm responds correctly (strong).

8. Real-world cross-check

  • 2021 revision: 5.28 km, 16 corners (one secondary guide); T5-T6 chicane removed, north hairpin widened, T11-T14 marina quartet replaced by one banked turn, hotel corners opened up - racer.com, f1technical, The Race, yasmarinacircuit.com. The built lap (5277 m, 16 curated turns) agrees with the post-2021 layout.
  • Pit-exit tunnel and the hotel straddling the track are not covered by the sources above; they come from the repo brief (docs/tracks/abudhabi.md) and are not independently verified here.
  • Source disagreement on Turns 4-6 (hairpin vs chicane removal) was not resolved.

9. Not captured / uncertain

  • No captures at 0.96-0.99 beyond the hotel pair, none at pit-lane level, no motion/flicker clips, no GLX/WGX backends (TLX default only), no phone-viewport run.
  • Cut from the plan: dawn rain, dusk wet/fog/overcast, night fog/overcast, eye/trackside for the other weathers (~40 frames). Dawn was captured dry only.
  • The weather matrix (not storm/hero) predates the PR #1979 lighting merge; only the day rain/wet f50 pair was re-shot after it.
  • Defects 3, 4, 6 and the black rectangle: mechanism not traced. The intent of the +0.1015 shift (defect 1) is not confirmed with the authors.
  • Software rendering only: colours, bloom and shadow looks are not evidence about a player's GPU.
